page.layout: One column of running text, with two small marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines "Deus olim" and "fcribentis". No notes in the right margin.

main_text.l: necesse est duplicem obseruari : unam, civilem
& humanam, secundùm quam hominem inter
homines necesse est inculpatè & fine crimine
ciuiliter viuere : alterà spiritualem & diuinam,
secundùm quam necesse est hominem quem-
que coram Domino ambulare inculpatè, &
esse integrum, vt cōtinetur verbis fœderis quod
Deus olim cum Abrahamo pepigit. Iuris hu-
mani præcepta tria prudentes tradiderunt: ho-
nestè viuere, alterum non lædere, & suum cui-
que tribuere. Etsi hæc duo, si quis accuratiùs
volet expendere, ad vnum & idem vidētur
pertinere. Nam qui suum cuique tribuit, non
lædit alterum: & contrà qui lædit alterum,
suum cuique minimè tribuit. Iuris autem di-
uini præcepta si quis in pauca volet contrahere,
commodè verbis Pauli vsurus est, ad Titum
scribentis hoc modo, Illuxit gratia illa Dei sa-
lutifera quibusquis hominibus, erudiens nos, vt
abnegata impietate & mundanis cupiditatibus,
sobriè, & iustè, & piè viuamus in præsenti sæ-
culo, expectantes beatā illam spem & illustrem
aduentum illum gloriæ magni illius Dei ac ser-
vatoris Iefu Christi. Nam proeo quòd huma-
næ iustitiæ fundamentum est natura; & lux,
sconscientia naturæ corruptissimæ : hic funda-
mentum supernaturale diuini iuris ponitur
gratia Dei salutaris; & lux gratiæ, sides in con-
scientia domesticorum Dei & piorum illucef-
cens. Proeo quòd opera humanæ iustitiæ il-
lius

page.notes: Marginal notes read "Gen.17." and "Tit.1." (the second is uncertain, marked by the position of the marker). Several words are uncertain because of the scan quality, particularly in the lines beginning "sconscientia", "supernaturale", "illucef-", and "lius". The lower line of the final word is not fully legible and was not transcribed further. Long s and u/v were normalised as instructed. Greek and printing errors such as "sconscientia" and "proeo" were left as printed.
